propositions: Push events on the tickets branch trigger CI workflows unnecessarily, starving the shared GitHub Actions runner pool because rebar auto-pushes the tickets branch on every write (comment, edit, claim, close).
Exactly four workflows push-trigger: test.yml, optionality.yml, prompt-eval.yml, verify-identity.yml, all using branches-ignore filter that must be extended to exclude tickets.

The tickets branch must be added to branches-ignore lists in the four push-triggering workflows while preserving existing exclusions (feature/**, main) and keeping schedule cron expressions unchanged.
A new enumerating test must assert that no workflow file in .github/workflows/ matches a push to tickets branch, with enforcement that future additions cannot silently regress this invariant.
Adopter-facing documentation must warn that any rebar user whose CI watches all branches will experience workflow starvation from auto-pushes and should configure CI to exclude the tickets branch.
